summary: @ornikar/kitt2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's declared preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub, writes it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` on the installer's host. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line file with the standard string-array-shuffle obfuscator shape (large numeric/string array plus a rotate function `MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())` and hex-named identifiers). This runs automatically on `npm install` with the installer's privileges, before any Node-based instrumentation gets a chance to observe the code, because execution happens under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime. The package advertises itself as a React/Tamagui UI kit under the `@ornikar` scope, but the install-time behavior is a heavily obfuscated non-UI payload unrelated to that stated purpose. The setup.mjs dropper itself uses renamed identifiers and string-lookup maps to obscure control flow.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
